text: This saved me from spending thousands of euros on medicine and surgeries. Did you know that if you add a tablespoon of olive oil, the juice of a lemon, and a tablespoon of molasses to a glass of coconut water, this mixture breaks down kidney stones, eliminates renal calculi, and cleanses the gallbladder. Coconut water provides minerals like iron, phosphorus, calcium, and magnesium that your kidneys need to function. It also hydrates at a cellular level in a way that regular water simply cannot. Olive oil lubricates the bile ducts and helps expel stones that are stuck. Lemon dissolves the calcium deposits that form kidney stones and creates an environment where they cannot keep growing. And molasses provides potassium and alkaline minerals that balance the pH and prevent new stones from forming. Mix everything together and drink it on an empty stomach every morning for two weeks. Within a few days, you may notice that the pain in your lower back decreases, that your urine flows better, and that the pressure you felt in your side starts to fade. Save this recipe. But I want you to understand something. Kidney stones don't form just from lack of water or because of food. In Chinese medicine, the kidneys are the organ that stores fear. Every worry you carry, every sleepless night, every emotion you swallow weakens the kidneys. When the kidneys are weak, they don't filter properly. Minerals accumulate and crystallize. Chronic stress also dehydrates the body from within because cortisol disrupts fluid balance. That's why some people drink liters of water and keep forming stones because they hydrate, but don't strengthen what is weakening them. This drink dissolves today's stones. But if fear and stress continue, they will form again. Write clean kidneys in the comments. If you are going to prepare this, and if you want to strengthen your kidneys from the root, I have spent more than 20 years quietly learning how to do it, and everything I know is inside the waybackto.com. The link is in my profile.
